_comments: Produce Video — runs a complete Video Studio multi-agent production in Autonomous mode and creates a standalone Video Production artifact.
Type='Custom' + DriverClass='Produce Video' binds to @RegisterClass(BaseAction, 'Produce Video').

fields.Name: Produce Video
fields.Description: Runs a full multi-stage Video Studio production (Director, Art Director, Storyboard, Pre-Production data snapshot and narration, Motion Engineer HTML/CSS/JS composition, deterministic HyperFrames render, and Critic review) and persists a standalone Video Production artifact plus MP4 and poster files in MJ: Files. Unlike Generate Video (which calls a generative video vendor to create a single raw video clip without composition, narration, or data bindings), Produce Video orchestrates an entire composed, brand-governed, data-bound video deliverable.
fields.CategoryID: @lookup:MJ: Action Categories.Name=Video Studio?create&Description=Actions for MemberJunction Video Studio — full multi-agent video productions and deliverables.

fields.Name: Topic
fields.Description: The video brief or topic in plain words; becomes the user message passed to the Video Studio agent.

fields.Name: Archetype
fields.Description: Optional name or ID of an Active MJ: Video Archetypes record (for example, 'KPI Briefing', 'Product Launch', 'Social Short').

fields.Name: BrandKit
fields.Description: Optional name or ID of an Active MJ: Brand Kits record. Defaults to the company's or org-wide default brand kit.

fields.Name: Formats
fields.Description: Optional comma-separated aspect ratios to render (for example, '16:9,9:16'). Defaults to the archetype's DefaultFormats.

fields.Name: DurationSeconds
fields.Description: Optional target runtime in seconds. Defaults to the archetype's DefaultDurationSeconds.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Optional MJ: Companies ID scoping archetype selection, brand kit selection, data bindings, and provenance.

fields.Name: PowerLevel
fields.Description: Optional agent configuration preset name or display name ('Draft', 'Standard', or 'High'). Defaults to the Video Studio agent's IsDefault preset.

fields.Name: DataRefs
fields.Description: Optional array of authoritative data references ({ Key, Kind: 'Query'|'View'|'Artifact', QueryID?, QueryName?, Parameters?, EntityName?, ExtraFilter?, Fields?, ArtifactVersionID?, Shape, Format?, Label? }) mapped to VideoDataBinding entries. Inline is refused; callers pass data by reference.

fields.Name: AgentRunID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ: AI Agent Runs row for the Video Studio execution.

fields.Name: ArtifactID
fields.Description: ID of the standalone Video Production (MJ: Artifacts) record created on completion.

fields.Name: ArtifactVersionID
fields.Description: ID of the MJ: Artifact Versions row containing the delivered VideoGenerationSpec JSON.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Final VideoProductionStatus of the specification (for example, 'Delivered').

fields.Name: VideoFileIDs
fields.Description: Object keyed by format ('16:9', '9:16', '1:1') mapping each rendered deliverable to its MJ: Files ID.

fields.Name: PosterFileID
fields.Description: MJ: Files ID of the captured poster still frame.

fields.Name: HumanReviewNotes
fields.Description: Summary of deferred defects, inline storage warnings, and AI-generated asset disclosures from Review.HumanReviewNotes.
